title: Punjab Tolls On Roads and Bridges Amendment Ordinance 2001

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Tolls On Roads and Bridges Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE I OF 2001
PUNJAB TOLLS ON
ROADS AND BRIDGES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE I OF 2001
An Ordinance
further to amend the Punjab Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance, 1962 (W P.
Ord. VIII of 1962)
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 23rd February, 2001]
No. Legis. 3(1)/2001, dated
23-2-2001.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the
Punjab is hereby published for general information:
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Punjab Tolls on Roads
and Bridges (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Tolls On Roads and Bridges Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Amendment of section 7 of W.P. Ordinance VIII of 1962

ORDINANCE I OF 2001
PUNJAB TOLLS ON
ROADS AND BRIDGES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE I OF 2001
An Ordinance
further to amend the Punjab Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance, 1962 (W P.
Ord. VIII of 1962)
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 23rd February, 2001]
No. Legis. 3(1)/2001, dated
23-2-2001.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the
Punjab is hereby published for general information:
2. Amendment of section 7 of
W.P. Ordinance VIII of 1962.--In the Punjab Tolls on Roads and Bridges
Ordinance (W.P. Ordinance VIII of 1962) hereinafter referred to as the said
Ordinance in section 7 in subsection (1) the following proviso shall be
added:--
"Provided that, in the case
of Build, Operate and Transfer (BOT) projects the period of lease may be such as
may be determined by the Government. "

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Tolls On Roads and Bridges Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Amendment of section 8 of W.P. Ordinance VIII of 1962

ORDINANCE I OF 2001
PUNJAB TOLLS ON
ROADS AND BRIDGES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE I OF 2001
An Ordinance
further to amend the Punjab Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance, 1962 (W P.
Ord. VIII of 1962)
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 23rd February, 2001]
No. Legis. 3(1)/2001, dated
23-2-2001.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the
Punjab is hereby published for general information:
3. Amendment of section 8 of
W.P. Ordinance VIII of 1962.--In the said Ordinance in section 8 the
following subsection (4) shall be added:--
"(4)
Notwithstanding anything contained in this section in the case of BOT contract
the lease shall be cancelled in accordance with the terms of the contract.
"
